text: A MERN-based platform for secure hostel operations, residents, facilities, and gate management
Prepared for project review and poster presentation

alt: SHMS dashboard screenshot from project recording

text: Hostel operations often rely on disconnected registers, calls, and manual follow-up.
Manual student, room, and bed records
Slow gate verification and movement tracking
Limited role control across hostel staff
No single view of occupancy and operations
SHMS centralizes hostel data under verified hostel context and role-based access.
The system supports real records, protected tenant data, resident administration, room allocation, photo handling, fee workflows, and QR-based gate activity.
The project focuses on operational clarity, data isolation, and secure role-based workflows.
Manage students, staff, parents, rooms, beds, and allocations in one system.
Verify the active hostel context on the backend for tenant-scoped data.
Support resident handling, facility management, payments, photos, and gate records.
Use lifecycle states and allocation history instead of removing important records.
The application uses a modern web stack with a separate client, API server, and MongoDB data layer.
Responsive user interface, component state, forms, dashboard
REST APIs, validation, authorization, secure file handling
Tenant-scoped documents, lifecycle fields, and model relations
Signed access tokens and protected password verification
Supporting libraries: Multer for uploads, Lucide React icons, HTML5 QR scanner, QRCode generator, and Google OAuth integration.
Six roles define what each person can access within the platform.
The current build contains working modules backed by API routes, model logic, and automated tests.
Blocks, floors, rooms, beds, lifecycle state
Warden and Guard creation with access control
One-time QR token and entry or exit records
Photo validation, preview, camera capture states
Core entities use hostelId to keep records within the verified hostel scope.
Relationships shown are simplified for presentation clarity. Each operational entity also retains tenant and lifecycle information where applicable.
SHMS acts as the central process for hostel users, records, and controlled operations.
Profiles, facility records, allocations, staff, payment actions
QR token requests, profile access, payment status
QR scan and entry or exit result
A request passes through authentication and tenant checks before the system performs a business operation.
Verify credentials and issue a signed token
Bind request to the verified hostel
Create, read, update, archive, or record activity
Write validated data and retain history
This server-side flow prevents a client from selecting another hostel or accessing data outside its membership.
Screens captured from the existing project recording show the dashboard, student management, photo flow, and facilities area.
The current interface uses responsive panels, role-aware navigation, feedback states, and a final animation layer with reduced-motion support.
Security controls belong in the backend, not only in the visible navigation.
Scrypt password hashing and signed JWT verification
hostelId is derived from verified membership context
Archive and restore preserve important records
Image type and signature validation with size limits
The current project has automated coverage for core security, lifecycle, and API behavior.
QR single-use and gate scan rules
Evidence reflects the most recent local test run performed during the project audit.
The project has a working foundation, with the next modules focused on resident services and reporting.
Hostel, facility, student, staff, parent modules
Photo, payment, QR, and gate workflows
Reports, exports, audit log UI, settings
The next work expands the current foundation without changing the established security model.
Outpass, complaints, help contacts, notices, notifications
Mess management, camera events, reports, export
Role dashboards, mobile verification, production deployment
The roadmap keeps tenant boundaries, role checks, lifecycle history, and real database values as non-negotiable rules.
SHMS provides a real, secure foundation for managing hostel operations across people, facilities, and daily activity.
The next development stages will complete resident services, reporting, and all remaining role-specific workflows.
